subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given word.

Chuckle

options.text: Laugh quietly without opening one's mouth
Laugh in a noisy, gleeful way

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"chuckle"** means to laugh quietly without opening one’s mouth. (चुपचाप हंसना)

 
 
• **Example: **She couldn’t help but chuckle at his silly joke.
 
 
 
• **"Laugh quietly without opening one’s mouth" **is the correct description of a chuckle. (चुपचाप हंसना)
 
 
• **Example: **He chuckled softly as he read the humorous comic strip.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate meaning of the word "chuckle" is "laugh quietly without opening one’s mouth".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Laugh loudly** (जोर से हंसना): Refers to laughing in a loud and unrestrained manner.

 
 
• **Example:** Everyone laughed loudly when the clown performed his tricks.
 
 
 
• **Cry like a donkey** (गधे की तरह रोना): Refers to a noisy and braying-like cry, which is unrelated to chuckling.
 
 
• **Example:** The child cried like a donkey when his toy broke.
 
 
 
• **Laugh in a noisy, gleeful way** (शोर मचाते हुए खुशी से हंसना): Refers to laughing loudly with joy but does not capture the quiet nature of a chuckle.
 
 
• **Example:** The audience laughed in a noisy, gleeful way during the comedy show.
 
 

3a:Tbbb,
The correct answer is **Option 3**.</d
